description: This file defines the WebSocketRouteBuilder interface, which provides a fluent API for constructing Akka HTTP routes for WebSocket connections within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for configuring event sniffers, authorization, supervision, signal enrichment, header translation, and route creation.

classes.name: WebSocketRouteBuilder
classes.description: An interface providing a fluent API for building WebSocket routes with configuration options for event sniffers, authorization, supervision, signal enrichment, header translation, and route creation.

methods.name: withIncomingEventSniffer
methods.description: Sets the event sniffer for incoming WebSocket messages, enabling message inspection or logging.

methods.name: withOutgoingEventSniffer
methods.description: Sets the event sniffer for outgoing WebSocket messages.

methods.name: withAuthorizationEnforcer
methods.description: Configures an authorization enforcer to enforce access control on WebSocket connections.

methods.name: withWebSocketSupervisor
methods.description: Sets a supervisor for WebSocket connections, enabling supervision strategies.

methods.name: withSignalEnrichmentProvider
methods.description: Sets a provider for enriching signals with additional fields; null or unset results in errors for requests with 'extraFields'.

methods.name: withHeaderTranslator
methods.description: Sets a header translator for mapping headers; null or unset results in errors for requests with 'extraFields'.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the Akka HTTP Route for WebSocket connections based on the configured parameters.
